text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe clinches a crucial victory at the Arima Kinen, but the fight is far from over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm positive that we'll be seeing more of Agnes Tachyon in our races to come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe's friend is an entity that evolves further the more ambitious she gets. This friend of hers is essentially a manifestation of Manhattan Cafe's own aspirations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe tells me that her friend got faster as I helped her improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We make a heartfelt promise to continue pursuing our ambitions together.
